PR #2832 pushed at head af034d76cc. It is now current with main (both new main commits merged, including #2835).
Changes since 5d2a30175d:
(1) Floor-list conflict resolved: the list keeps main's pr_ship_batch.rs and this branch's ratchet test file, and pr_ship_batch.rs carries the mandate-gate marker.
(2) Main's pr_ship_batch T8 test now uses the two-argument touches_gates.
(3) scripts/config-trust.toml: mandate_gates.rs now has 6 sites; the two PathSource labels are classified prose; trusted (origin/main) and home (~/.aida) are unchanged.
Gates: 160 targeted tests, then ship-batch + ratchet + config-trust 42/42 after the second merge; make check-ci-compile passed; make check-ci-fast passed all 34 gates. This is a human merge; I have not shipped or cleared anything.
